checks.description: Verify the Phase 6 mobile screen registry is complete in dependency-light package tests.
checks.evidenceRequired: Package test output proving every expected screen is registered exactly once.

checks.description: Launch the Expo app on iOS simulator and capture every registered screen.
checks.evidenceRequired: iOS simulator screenshots or video covering auth, home, bookings, appointments, clients, travel, portfolio, notifications, offline, and system screens.

checks.description: Launch the Expo app on Android emulator and capture every registered screen.
checks.evidenceRequired: Android emulator screenshots or video covering auth, home, bookings, appointments, clients, travel, portfolio, notifications, offline, and system screens.

checks.description: Verify signed-in, signed-out, expired, and biometric-locked states once auth is wired.
checks.command: manual device QA with Expo LocalAuthentication
checks.evidenceRequired: Device transcript proving lock, unlock, logout, and expired-session behavior.

checks.description: Verify mobile API calls include auth, tenant scope, request ids, idempotency, and safe error handling.
checks.command: manual device QA against preview API
checks.evidenceRequired: Seeded preview API transcript proving auth headers, tenant scope, request ids, and safe errors.

checks.description: Create offline notes, reference metadata, and travel status updates while disconnected, then verify sync reconciliation.
checks.evidenceRequired: Device logs proving encrypted queue persistence, idempotent replay, retry, and conflict handling.

checks.description: Register device token, send Expo push test, and verify opt-out and redaction behavior.
checks.command: Expo push token registration and test push
checks.evidenceRequired: Push token registration proof, opt-out blocking proof, delivery receipt, and tap deep-link screenshot.

checks.description: Force a safe mobile crash and verify sanitized crash capture in preview.
checks.command: forced safe mobile crash in preview build
checks.evidenceRequired: Sanitized crash event in Sentry/fallback report with no PII, medical, payment, or token data.

checks.description: Publish a preview EAS update, verify adoption, and rehearse rollback by republishing a previous compatible update.
checks.evidenceRequired: Preview update adoption screenshot and rollback republish proof on the same runtime.

checks.description: Run VoiceOver/TalkBack, text scaling, contrast, and touch-target QA on device.
checks.evidenceRequired: VoiceOver/TalkBack notes, text scaling screenshots, contrast/touch target findings.
